verdict.rationale: Hugging Face's Inference Providers offer access to 'hundreds of additional open-weights models' through a single OpenAI-compatible API. GPT-OSS is documented explicitly (openai/gpt-oss-120b), and an independent incident report shows inference requests to DeepSeek-V4, DeepSeek-V3.1, Qwen3-235B and Kimi-K2.6 served on Hugging Face. Because not every named family and the shared-serverless nature are documented, this is partial rather than full. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that Llama models are in the provider catalog, first-party documentation listing the Qwen/DeepSeek families, and explicit documentation that these run on shared serverless (not dedicated) endpoints.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose among a broad catalog of current open-weight model families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS and peers) on shared serverless endpoints

citations.quote: Just swap-out the base URL to instantly access hundreds of additional open-weights models through our provider network.
You can also select the provider of your choice by appending the provider name to the model id (e.g. `"openai/gpt-oss-120b:groq"`).
Point it at Inference Providers to run [the latest open models available](https://huggingface.co/models?inference_provider=all) with a single Hugging Face token.
These included GPT-2 (prompt "Hi"), DeepSeek-V4-Pro/Flash, Kimi-K2.6, DeepSeek-V3.1 and Qwen3-235B-A22B
